# M11-D/E/F — historical two-session replay evidence

The complete M11-D/E/F reference is preserved, unchanged, at
[the exact accepted historical source](https://github.com/AndriiKhanin/mcp-agent-security-test-suite/blob/89a856a57c5905aeb336c5863d1b4e0b7769a1ea/.github/M11_REPLAY_SESSION.md).

Tracking: [Issue #230](https://github.com/AndriiKhanin/mcp-agent-security-test-suite/issues/230).

From a reviewed checkout, the historical first-party fixed test can be
reproduced with `node tools/m11-replay-session.mjs`. It is not a real AI agent
and does not connect to an external MCP server.
This archived M11 material describes fictional first-party tests only,
not a live MCP scanner. The canonical 240-file/2MB excluded-source
custody continues to hash this pointer file. No original bytes were
deleted from Git history or rewritten. F1 current instructions are in
[Getting Started](../docs/GETTING_STARTED.md); external live-target
authorization remains [blocked](https://github.com/AndriiKhanin/mcp-agent-security-test-suite/issues/21).
